items.title: 16.7 Basic radicals ki pehchan ke tests (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.7 with Quick Check 16.4, printed pages 345-348.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Basic radicals (cations, yani positive ions) ki pehchan ke liye aam tor par sample ko distilled water mein ghol kar solution do hisson mein baanta jata hai: ek hisse mein NaOH solution aur doosre mein aqueous ammonia dala jata hai. Precipitate ka rang aur zyada reagent (excess) mein us ka ghulna ya na ghulna ion batata hai.
a) Aluminium (Al³⁺) radical ki pehchan
Saaf test tube mein 4 g solid sample lein. Taqreeban 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Do hisson (parts) mein baant lein.

blocks.caption: Aluminium radical ki pehchan
rows: Pehle hisse mein taqreeban 5 cm³ NaOH solution dalein.
Safed gelatinous (jelly jaisa) precipitate banta hai.
Al³⁺ ions maujood hain.
Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia ke chand qatre dalein.
Safed precipitate banta hai.
Al³⁺ ions maujood hain.

blocks.text: b) Ammonium (NH₄¹⁺) radical ki pehchan

blocks.caption: Ammonium radical ki pehchan
rows: Saaf test tube mein 4 g sample lein, 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. NaOH solution dal kar halka sa garam karein.
Khaas boo wali ammonia gas nikalti hai. Ammonia gas geele laal litmus ko neela kar deti hai.
NH₄¹⁺ ions maujood hain.

blocks.text: c) Calcium (Ca²⁺) radical ki pehchan
Saaf test tube mein 4 g solid sample lein. 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Do hisson (parts) mein baant lein.

blocks.caption: Calcium radical ki pehchan
rows: Pehle hisse mein NaOH solution dalein.
Safed precipitate banta hai jo zyada (excess) NaOH mein nahi ghulta.
Ca²⁺ ions maujood hain.
Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia dalein.
Sirf halka sa dhundlapan (turbidity) aata hai ya koi precipitate nahi banta.
Ca²⁺ ions maujood hain.

blocks.text: d) Chromium (Cr³⁺) radical ki pehchan
Saaf test tube mein 4 g sample lein. 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Do hisson (parts) mein baant lein.

blocks.caption: Chromium radical ki pehchan
rows: Pehle hisse mein NaOH solution dalein.
Sabz (green) precipitate banta hai jo zyada NaOH dalne par sabz solution ban jata hai.
Cr³⁺ ions maujood hain.
Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia dalein.
Sabz precipitate banta hai jo zyada ammonia mein nahi ghulta.
Cr³⁺ ions maujood hain.

blocks.text: e) Copper (Cu²⁺) radical ki pehchan
Saaf test tube mein 4 g solid sample lein. 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Do hisson (parts) mein baant lein.

blocks.caption: Copper radical ki pehchan
rows: Pehle hisse mein NaOH solution dalein.
Halka neela (light-blue) precipitate banta hai.
Cu²⁺ ions maujood hain.
Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia dalein.
Gehra neela (deep blue) solution banta hai.
Cu²⁺ ions maujood hain.

blocks.alt: Teen test tubes: halka neela [Cu(H2O)6]2+; thori ammonia se neela precipitate [Cu(H2O)4(OH)2] (ammonia base ka kaam karti hai); zyada ammonia se gehra neela solution [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+ (ligand exchange reaction).
blocks.caption: Cu2+ ions thori aur zyada ammonia ke saath (kitab mein chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle qadam mein ammonia base ban kar do H2O se proton leti hai, is liye neutral [Cu(H2O)4(OH)2] precipitate banta hai. Zyada ammonia dalne par NH3 khud ligand ban kar pani ki jagah le leti hai (ligand exchange), aur gehra neela complex ion solution mein hal ho jata hai.
f) Iron (II) (Fe²⁺) radical ki pehchan
Saaf test tube mein 4 g sample lein. 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Do hisson (parts) mein baant lein.

blocks.caption: Iron (II) radical ki pehchan
rows: Pehle hisse mein NaOH solution dalein.
Sabz precipitate banta hai jo kuch der baad orange-bhoora (orange brown) ho jata hai.
Fe²⁺ ions maujood hain.
Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia dalein.
Fe(OH)₂ ka safed gelatinous precipitate banta hai jo jaldi hawa se oxidize ho kar Fe(OH)₃ ka laal-bhoora precipitate ban jata hai.
Fe²⁺ ions maujood hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Fe(OH)₂ hawa ki oxygen se dheere dheere Fe(OH)₃ mein badalta hai; isi liye sabz (ya halka) precipitate kuch der baad orange-bhoora ho jata hai. Saaf Fe(OH)₂ safed hota hai magar aam tor par lab mein halka sabz nazar aata hai.
f) Iron (III) (Fe³⁺) radical ki pehchan
Saaf test tube mein 2 g FeCl₃ lein. 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Do hisson (parts) mein baant lein.

blocks.caption: Iron (III) radical ki pehchan
rows: Pehle hisse mein NaOH solution dalein.
Orange-bhoora precipitate banta hai.
Fe³⁺ ions maujood hain.
Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia dalein.
Orange-bhoora precipitate banta hai.
Fe³⁺ ions maujood hain.

blocks.text: g) Zinc (Zn²⁺) radical ki pehchan
Saaf test tube mein 4 g solid sample lein. 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Do hisson (parts) mein baant lein.

blocks.caption: Zinc radical ki pehchan
rows: Pehle hisse mein NaOH solution dalein.
Safed precipitate banta hai jo zyada NaOH mein ghul jata hai.
Zn²⁺ ions maujood hain.
Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia dalein.
Safed precipitate banta hai jo zyada ammonia mein ghul jata hai.
Zn²⁺ ions maujood hain.

blocks.caption: Milte julte nataij alag karna
rows: NaOH se safed ppt: Ca2+, Al3+, Zn2+

blocks.text: Quick Check 16.4

blocks.prompt: a) Lake test kya hai? Equation dein.
blocks.explanation: Yeh Al³⁺ ka test hai. Al³⁺ solution mein thora NaOH (ya ammonia) dal kar Al(OH)₃ ka precipitate banayein aur us mein neela litmus solution dalein. Gelatinous Al(OH)₃ dye (rang) ko apne upar jazb kar leta hai aur neeli tah ('blue lake') ban jati hai: Al³⁺ + 3OH⁻ → Al(OH)₃, phir Al(OH)₃ + litmus → blue lake.

blocks.prompt: b) Ammonium ion kaise pehchana jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Sample ko NaOH solution ke saath halka garam karein. Khaas boo wali ammonia gas nikalti hai jo geele laal litmus ko neela kar deti hai: NH₄⁺ + OH⁻ → NH₃ + H₂O.

blocks.prompt: c) Ferrous (Fe²⁺) aur ferric (Fe³⁺) radicals mein farq kaise karenge?
blocks.explanation: NaOH dalne par Fe²⁺ sabz precipitate (Fe(OH)₂) deta hai jo kuch der baad orange-bhoora ho jata hai, jabke Fe³⁺ foran orange-bhoora precipitate (Fe(OH)₃) deta hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Cu²⁺ solution mein aq. NH₃ thori (limited) aur zyada (excess) miqdar mein dalne se kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Thori ammonia se halka neela precipitate (Cu(OH)₂, ya [Cu(H₂O)₄(OH)₂]) banta hai. Zyada ammonia dalne par yeh precipitate ghul jata hai aur [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺ complex ka gehra neela solution ban jata hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: NaOH ke saath: Al³⁺ safed gelatinous; NH₄¹⁺ garam karne par NH₃; Ca²⁺ safed (excess mein nahi ghulta); Cr³⁺ sabz (excess mein ghulta); Cu²⁺ halka neela; Fe²⁺ sabz jo bhoora ho; Fe³⁺ orange-bhoora; Zn²⁺ safed (excess mein ghulta).

Aqueous NH₃ ke saath: Al³⁺ safed; Ca²⁺ halka dhundlapan ya kuch nahi; Cr³⁺ sabz (excess mein nahi ghulta); Cu²⁺ gehra neela solution; Fe²⁺ safed jo laal-bhoora ho; Fe³⁺ orange-bhoora; Zn²⁺ safed jo excess mein ghul jaye.
